question: We rebranded last month (finally!) but the old business name is still sitting at the top of every page. Where do I change that?

articles.title: Change your client name
articles.body:
Your **Client name** appears at the top of every page in Harbour CRM.

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Change the **Client name**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

answer: Your **Client name** appears at the top of every page. To change it: 1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**. 2. Change the **Client name**. 3. Select **Save client profile**.
